messages.author: Antigravity
messages.content: Redesigned for iPhone with a single-row header, top composer, and swipeable suggestions (`v0.3.0`).

messages.author: Antigravity
messages.content: Switched to **Low-Token Delta Architecture (`v0.4.0`)**: extracted `custom.css` (22 lines) and `stage-custom.js` (12 lines) and trimmed `state.json` so future requests edit only tiny delta files (~85% fewer tokens per prompt).

suggestions.title: Pomodoro & Task Deck
suggestions.prompt: Evolve the stage into a Personal Command Deck with a Pomodoro timer and task queue.

suggestions.title: Touch XY Audio Synth
suggestions.prompt: Add a playable WebAudio synthesizer and XY expression pad with preset chords.

suggestions.title: Spatial Note Cards
suggestions.prompt: Build an interactive spatial note-taking board where I can create thought cards.

suggestions.title: Warm Paper Theme
suggestions.prompt: Switch the theme to a warm alabaster paper editorial aesthetic.

changelog.summary: Low-Token Delta Mode: split custom.css & stage-custom.js and compacted state.json (~85% fewer tokens/request).
